linda-mgr: Quick Q — need to propose an out-of-cycle (OOC) promotion + comp bump for Samantha (IC) after she ran the cross-team incident and owned migration. Is OOC allowed and what docs do we need?

people-ops: OOC promotions are possible but reserved for "exceptional" cases. We'll need: manager justification, evidence of sustained impact (not just single incident), peer calibration notes, proposed comp adjustment and source of funds, exec sponsor if > 15% or includes equity refresh.

linda-mgr: She id lead the migration which saved ~30% infra spend and unblocked three product launches. This isn't a one-off ut 6 months of expanded scope. Would that count?

jamal-comp: Sounds promising. Two quick things: 1) define the request as either "level change" (L4) or "comp only". 2) If comp change >15% salary bump, it needs exec sponsor and Finance approval. Provide target band percentile (e.g., 75th) rather than absolute $$. 

rita-fin: Also need to know funding source: hiring budget reallocation vs. spot bonus pool vs. departmental discretionary. If we reallocate headcount budget, we need GC sign-off and updated forecast numbers.

linda-mgr: I expect ~18% bump + title L4. I can sponsor reforecast but need to know the form.

people-ops: Use the "ooc-promo-exception" form, link: https://hr.redwood.com/forms/ooc-promo. Required fields: employee_id, manager, current_level, requested_level, comp_change_pct, funding_source, evidence_summary, exec_sponsor, proposed_effective_date, equity_refresh_yes_no. Attach peer notes and repo links.

people-ops-bot: form_template: {
  "employee_id": "RWD-9812",
  "manager": "linda-mgr",
  "current_level": "L3",
  "requested_level": "L4",
  "comp_change_pct": "18",
  "funding_source": "team_headcount_realloc",
  "evidence_summary": "Led infra migration; 30% infra cost reduction; shipped cross-team integration; mentoring two new ICs",
  "exec_sponsor": "ceo-sponsor",
  "proposed_effective_date": "2029-07-01",
  "equity_refresh_yes_no": "yes"
}

jamal-comp: If equity_refresh_yes_no=yes, note that equity approvals go through Finance + Legal and add 7-10 business days. Prepare equity rationale (market + retention).

payroll-bot: FYI payroll run constraints: standard payroll cutoff for OOC adjustments is 1901243200 UTC. Off-cycle runs can be requested but require payroll team lead approval; there is usually a 3-business-day processing window.

linda-mgr: If we miss cutoff, can we backdate to proposed_effective_date?

people-ops: We can request retroactive pay to the effective date if the committee approves, but payroll timing sometimes causes partial delay. For >30 days retro requests we need exec sign-off and Finance confirmation.

ceo-sponsor: Happy to sponsor if the packet is strong. Please include customer impact metrics, a before/after scope table, and 2-3 anonymized peer calibration notes.

linda-mgr: For peer calibration, do we need signed forms or informal Slack snippets?

people-ops: Short anonymized bullets are fine. Example: "Peer A: Samantha consistently delivers cross-team projects; recommendation: L4". Put 2-3 of those in the packet.

jamal-comp: Also include internal comp comparisons: list 2-3 peers at L4 and their approximate percentile bands (no exact salaries). This helps committee calibrate.

samantha: Thanks for the heads-up, Linda. I'm happy to help build impact bullets and link PRs.

linda-mgr: Great — I'll draft the packet and loop Finance + Jamal. If we mark it urgent can committee meet earlier?

people-ops: We can call an ad-hoc comp committee for urgent OOC requests if exec sponsor requests it and materials are complete. Expect 48-72h turnaround if everyone is available.

rita-fin: I'll need a short budget note (1-paragraph) and which GL codes to adjust. Ping me once the packet is near-final.

linda-mgr: Noted. Final question: does an OOC promotion change headcount for hiring/OKRs?

people-ops: Level changes don't change headcount, but if you reallocate budget from hiring to comp it affects current hiring plans. Flag your hiring queue to avoid double-spend.

linda-mgr: Got it. I'll submit the ooc form today with exec sponsor cc and mark "urgent". Thanks all. :thumbsup:
